name: Focus
summary: The admin app at the center of your scene.
blurb: Bring its venues, people and events into one cohesive view, and manage your audience from your phone or iPad.

name: Velvet
alt: Velvet's violet rope between gold stanchions
summary: For the places where your scene comes together.
blurb: Run the door, tonight's lineup and your venue's chat from one app, on the counter or behind the rope.

name: Backstage
alt: Backstage's violet access pass with an illuminated doorway
summary: For the people who make the scene.
blurb: The app for performers, hosts and the talent behind every gathering. Keep your profile and appearances current.
